memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: In the western foothills: Eshtaol, Zorah, Ashnah, Zanoah, En Gannim, Tappuah, Enam, Jarmuth, Adullam, Sokoh, Azekah, Shaaraim, Adithaim and Gederah (or Gederothaim)—fourteen towns and their villages; Zenan, Hadashah, Migdal Gad, Dilean, Mizpah, Joktheel, Lachish, Bozkath, Eglon, Kabbon, Lahmas, Kitlish, Gederoth, Beth Dagon, Naamah and Makkedah—sixteen towns and their villages - Josh 15:33-41 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
The list continues into the western foothills, the lowland region between the mountains and the coast. Again the towns are carefully numbered — fourteen here, sixteen there. God's Word keeps a precise account of every settlement in Judah's inheritance, leaving nothing to guesswork.

Behind this careful counting lies a truth about God's faithfulness. Long ago He had promised Abraham a land for his descendants (Gen 15:18-21). Now, generation after generation later, that promise is being fulfilled town by town, foothill by foothill. Every named settlement is a piece of a promise kept. What God had spoken as a word to one wandering man is now solid ground beneath a whole tribe.

This is how God works out His promises — not in a single dramatic moment, but faithfully, thoroughly, over long stretches of time. The distance between a promise given and a promise fulfilled can feel enormous while we are living in it. But God does not forget what He has spoken. Every town in this list is proof that He completes what He begins. Whatever promise of God you are waiting on, take heart from these foothill towns: in Christ, every one of God's promises finds its Yes (2 Cor 1:20).

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
- What promise of God are you still waiting to see fulfilled?
- How do these carefully counted towns encourage you about God's faithfulness?
- Do you believe God completes, over time, what He has begun in you?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Faithful God, every town in this list is proof that You keep Your word. Help me to trust that You will complete what You have promised, however long the waiting. Amen.
